summary.text: Bill Tveit is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 33 (Hazen) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Bill Tveit's service as "House since 2019". The member page lists Bill Tveit's committee assignments as including the Agriculture and the Judiciary standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Bill Tveit's occupation as Retired, Farm Equipment Owner/Dealer.
It lists military service as US Army (1968-1971).

It lists these affiliations and civic roles: NCSL Energy Task Force; Past Chair, Mercer County Commissioner; Past Chair, Dakota Central Social Services; Past President, ND John Deere Dealer Group; 65th session Senate Deputy Sergeant-at-Arms; Vice Chair, Interim Agriculture & Natural Resources; Interdenominational Riverdale Community Church.
Bill Tveit is listed as married to Laurel with 3 children, 10 grandchildren and 3 great grandchildren.
